headline: Implementation and Technical Support Lead | Practice Software Rollouts, Escalations, Playbooks | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: I spent four years at Greenway Health, a US practice-management and EHR company, taking close to 200 client practices from readiness through configuration, training and go-live. I worked directly with practice owners, managers, doctors and front-desk staff, triaged defects with product and engineering, and turned recurring problems into fixes that shipped. I also built and run Roovero, my own SaaS, so I know what an engineering team needs from a support ticket.
greenway_bullets: Led implementations for close to 200 client practices on Greenway's EHR and practice-management software: readiness, workflow discovery, configuration, testing, training and go-live support.
Worked with practice owners, managers, physicians and administrative staff to document how they actually worked and configure practice-specific workflows and widgets.

Took client issues from first report to resolution, separated configuration and training problems from real defects, and wrote clear feature requests and bug reports for product teams; many fixes and features shipped.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, and wrote the guides that kept training consistent.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: mapped clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
skills: readiness assessment, configuration, data and workflow review, testing, go-live and stabilization, post-launch reviews
issue reproduction, root-cause triage, escalation to engineering, release validation, knowledge-base and playbook writing
webhooks and API integrations, Firebase, Next.js, React, GitHub, AI-assisted development with Claude Code and Codex
thesis_html: Clinic rollouts that go live cleanly, and stay that way.
why_fit: Readiness, configuration, training and launch support on practice-management and EHR software.
I wrote the tickets and sat on the committee that decided what shipped and when.
I've worked in clinics and I've configured software for them, so I know where workflows break.
